title: ChatGPT automates removing your personal data from web and #Privacy #DataProtection #
description: This concept demonstrates how to leverage ChatGPT to systematically erase one's digital footprint by identifying and opting out of data broker and people search sites that collect and sell personal information. The process involves using ChatGPT to search for all instances of your personal data online, generate tailored removal requests, and automatically submit them via an integrated browsing or agent mode. Additionally, it includes an ongoing monitoring step to ensure data brokers comply with removal requests. The insight here is that many people are unaware of the extent to which their information is available and monetized online, and automating the removal process makes digital privacy management accessible and efficient. This method resonates widely due to growing privacy concerns and the complexity involved in manually opting out of multiple data services. From a consumer standpoint, the approach offers a scalable, user-friendly solution to regain control over personal information online, highlighting the practical use of AI tools for personal data protection. #DigitalPrivacy #DataRemoval #ChatGPT #PrivacyProtection #OnlineSecurity #DataBrokers #PersonalData #PrivacyTools #AIPrivacy #DataProtection #IdentityProtection #TechTips #CyberSecurity #PrivacyMatters #DataPrivacy

top_comments.author: @What-What-1s
top_comments.text:
False. There is no magic "agent mode" that can autonomously navigate the web, fill out forms, and submit them on your behalf. Even in the video's own screen recording at 00:37 you can briefly see the automated browser fail with a "Site Unavailable" error. Data brokers actively block automated bots from submitting forms. Furthermore, almost all opt-out processes require human verification that AI cannot bypass, such as:
Solving a visual CAPTCHA.Clicking a confirmation link sent to a private email inbox.
Answering a phone call.

top_comments.author: @Ascender342
top_comments.text:
Incorrect.

James Bond does not use chat gpt for getting his work done. He literally is an asset of MI6, which is one of the best intelligence agencies on earth. Using Q’s help and a simple authorisation from M, he can instantly have his identity deleted from every crevice of the web if any.

Also, what makes you think that he would have his actual identity still there in the first place? His existence was wiped out the moment he was selected
